verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment for developer integrations is a fair question for a secrets-management platform with APIs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test account, or non-production environment for trying 1Password integrations. Service-account vault scoping and 1Password Environments, which store app secrets, are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
